Here’s a quick reference of the available file‑system tools you can use:

| Function | Purpose |
|----------|---------|
| `cat` | View the contents of a file (no path, just the file name) |
| `cd` | Change the current working directory (one level up or down) |
| `cp` | Copy a file or directory locally (no paths, just names) |
| `diff` | Compare two files line‑by‑line |
| `du` | Estimate disk usage of the current directory |
| `echo` | Write or display text to a file |
| `find` | Recursively search for files/directories by name |
| `grep` | Search for a pattern inside a file |
| `ls` | List the contents of the current directory (optionally show hidden files) |
| `mkdir` | Create a new directory |
| `mv` | Move or rename a file/directory |
| `pwd` | Show the current working directory |
| `rm` | Delete a file or directory |
| `sort` | Sort the lines of a file |
